messages:
lina: Heads-up bringing up morpheus13b int4 canary on A10G. seeing intermittent OOMs around ~1.8k gen when 3+ long requests overlap. attaching short repro.

omar: can you paste runtime + args and a tiny log snippet? also which kernel variant?

lina: runtime v2.3.2, kernel=optimized-attn-v2. args:
```
--quant=int4 --prefetch=true --batch-size=14 --max_new_tokens=2048 --kv_reserve=0.12
```
log:
```
[2026-03-23T14:02:11Z] slab stripe expand 64->192MB
[2026-03-23T14:02:12Z] kv_prefetch miss burst 82%
[2026-03-23T14:02:12Z] GPU alloc fail 64MB -> OOM
```

sasha: pattern looks like synchronized prefetch waves + large max_new_tokens. quick mitigations: drop max_new_tokens to 1024 for canary, reduce batch_size to 8, raise kv_reserve to 0.22, enable staggered_prefetch. tradeoff = p95 + ~8-10%.

rafi: +1. also add a soft fallback: on alloc fail requeue to kernel=v1 or int8 variant for that request. add CI smoke job that runs 20 long-turn traces and asserts 0 OOMs and p95 <= baseline*1.15.

lina: applied local patch and reprobed:
```
max_new_tokens: 1024
batch_size: 8
kv_reserve: 0.22
runtime.flags: staggered_prefetch=true, enable_async_compact=true
```
repro: 0 OOMs over 1k runs, p95 latency +9% avg.

omar: can you open a PR gated by CI smoke? dev-bot can we add job and flag?

dev-bot: created job morpheus-int4-longtrace-smoke. thresholds: 0 OOMs, p95 <= baseline*1.15. feature.flag morpheus.int4_safety enabled for canary cohort (5%).

sasha: great. monitoring checklist: slab-stripe-by-node, kv-miss-heatmap, fallback-rate. if nightly quality eval shows >2% token-acc delta on long-list prompts, route those prompt classes to int8.

rafi: plan: ship canary defaults change to 5% traffic, wait 2h, if stable expand to 20%. keep quick rollback ready (revert defaults and disable stagger).

lina: rolling in 3m. initial telemetry after 15m: KV miss down ~28%, slab spikes reduced, no OOMs so far, p95 +8. holding canary. will post CI results and nightly eval. thanks all. :thumbsup:
